_note: UNSIGNED draft. The report definitions Hair's report@1 steps name, by key, and under `metrics` the metric definitions they read (src/reports/). The wrap-up layouts are Hair's own v1 definitions, their {{ }} in v2's template words over `report`; the leaderboard and the end-of-day list say what v1 computed in code; availability and the health sweep are read from vendors.

metrics._note: UNSIGNED draft. Hair's metrics, as data over the projections (src/reports/metrics.ts). Each cites the v1 metric-registry entry whose meaning it keeps; `v2` says where v1 read GHL live and v2 reads the fact log instead.

leads.label: Leads
leads.what: people who came in as leads (lead.created), by the day they came in, split by their source
leads.v1: metric-registry leads: GHL contacts by the date GHL added them (GHL live); v2 counts the lead.created facts

mqls.label: MQLs
mqls.what: leads of the period whose answer to the offer's qualifying question (the contact field leads.qualifying_field names) is one of its MQL answers (leads.mql_answers); not there while either is unset
mqls.v1: metric-registry mqls: leads whose qualifying answer is one of the offer's MQL answers (GHL live)

booked.label: Bookings made
booked.what: bookings made in the period (the act of booking), any call type
booked.v1: metric-registry booked: bookings by booked_at, by the closer booked with, from the booking source

booked_self.label: Self-booked
booked_self.what: bookings made in the period that the person booked themselves

booked_set.label: Setter-booked
booked_set.what: bookings made in the period that a setter booked, by that setter

reschedules.label: Reschedules
reschedules.what: times a booked call was moved, by when it was moved

dials.label: Dials
dials.what: outbound dialer calls made in the period, by who dialled
dials.v1: metric-registry dials (setter metrics: outbound dialer calls)

connected.label: Connected calls
connected.what: outbound dials the CRM marked connected and at least the offer's reached-seconds long (calls.reached_seconds); not there while it is unset
connected.v1: metric-registry connected: connected and at least companies.reached_seconds long

speed_to_lead.label: Speed to lead
speed_to_lead.what: median minutes from a lead arriving to the first outbound dial (leads never dialled are not counted)

closes.label: Closes
closes.what: deals won in the period (deal.won), credited to the closer of the person's latest call
closes.v1: metric-registry closes: won Closer-pipeline cards in GHL by when won, credited to the closer of their latest call (GHL live); v2 counts the ledger's deal.won facts

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.what: value of the deals won in the period (a deal with no value of its own is worth the program's price, payments.contract_value)
revenue.v1: metric-registry revenue: value of the won Closer-pipeline cards in GHL (GHL live)

cash_collected.label: Cash collected
cash_collected.what: payments in, refunds out, by when they happened, credited to the closer of the person's latest call
cash_collected.v1: metric-registry cash_collected: GHL Payment records, refunds out, credited to the record's closer (GHL live); v2 reads the payment facts

cash_gross.label: Payments
cash_gross.what: succeeded payments in the period, before refunds

calls_due.label: Calls booked
calls_due.what: closing calls whose time fell in the period and has passed, cancellations included, a slot rescheduled on the call not
calls_due.v1: metric-registry calls_booked_due: Sales Call records whose call time fell in the period and passed (GHL live)

shows.label: Shows
shows.what: those calls whose outcome is showed

no_shows.label: No-shows
no_shows.what: those calls whose outcome is no-show

calls_missing.label: Calls with no outcome
calls_missing.what: those calls with no outcome filed, not cancelled

calls_rescheduled.label: Rescheduled on the call
calls_rescheduled.what: slots rescheduled on the call (listed, not counted as due)

show_rate.label: Show rate
show_rate.what: shows ÷ calls booked whose time has passed

close_rate.label: Close rate
close_rate.what: closes ÷ shows in the same period

reports.availability.v1: v1 counted bookable slots in code (availability.ts) and raised a low-availability alert (H7); in a run about a booking, only that booking's calendar is read; a vendor read (the calendars), answered by the scheduling connector
